'''Pierangelo Metrangolo''' (born 16 April 1972) is an Italian chemist with interests in [[supramolecular chemistry]]<ref>P. Metrangolo et al. ''Halogen Bonding: A Paradigm in Chemistry'' Chemistry – A European Journal 2001, 7, 2511–2519 (DOI: 10.1002/1521-3765(20010618)7:12<2511::AID-CHEM25110>3.0.CO;2-T)</ref> and functional materials.<ref>P. Metrangolo et al. ''The Halogen Bond in the Design of Functional Supramolecular Materials: Recent Advances'' Accounts of Chemical Research 2013, 46, 2686–2695 (DOI: 10.1021/ar400103r)</ref> He also has an interest in [[crystal engineering]],<ref>''Halogen Bonding". – Fundamentals and Applications'' Metrangolo P. and Resnati G. Eds.; 2018; Springer; Berlin, Heidelberg, New York. {{ISBN|978-3-540-74330-9}}</ref> in particular by using the [[halogen bond]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.iupac.org/nc/home/projects/project-db/project-details.html?tx_wfqbe_pi1%5bproject_nr%5d=2009-032-1-100|title=Metrangolo chaired an IUPAC project on the definition of the halogen bond}}</ref><ref>P. Metrangolo et al. ''Halogen versus hydrogen'' Science 2008, 321, 918–919 (DOI: 10.1126/science.1162215)</ref> He is past-president of the Physical and Biophysical Chemistry Division (DIV. I) of IUPAC.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.cmic.polimi.it/en/persone/docenti-e-ricercatori/metrangolo-pierangelo/ |title=CMIC – Metrangolo Pierangelo  |access-date= 25 March 2022}}</ref>

==Education and professional positions==
Metrangolo was born in [[Lecce]], Italy. He obtained his PhD in Industrial Chemistry at the [[University of Milan]] in 2001 with a thesis on [[halogen bonding]] in [[supramolecular chemistry]].<ref>P. Metrangolo et al. ''Halogen Bonding in Supramolecular Chemistry'' Angewandte Chemie International Edition 2008, 47, 6114–6127 (DOI: 10.1002/anie.200800128)</ref> He became assistant professor at the [[Politecnico di Milano]] in 2002, where he was promoted to associate professor in 2005 and to full professor of chemistry for technologies in 2011. He is also affiliated to the [[National Research Council (Italy)|National Research Council]] of Italy and holds a visiting professorship at the [[Aalto University]] (Finland, since 2015) and at the [[VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland|VTT-Technical Research Centre of Finland]] (since 2011).

==Research interests==
His research interests have covered the following topics:
* functional supramolecular materials<ref>P. Metrangolo et al. ''Halogen-bonded Mesogens Direct Polymer Self-assemblies up to Millimetre Length Scale'' Nature Communications 2014, 5:4043 (DOI: 10.1038/ncomms5043)</ref><ref>P. Metrangolo et al. ''Transmembrane anion transport mediated by halogen-bond donors'' Nature Communications 2012, 3:905 (DOI: 10.1038/ncomms1902)</ref>
* fluorinated [[nanoparticle]]s and theranostics<ref>P. Metrangolo et al. ''A Superfluorinated Molecular Probe for Highly Sensitive in Vivo 19F‑MRI'' Journal of the American Chemical Society 2014, 136, 8524–8527 (DOI:  10.1021/ja503270n)</ref>
* biomimetic and biosynthetic [[hybrid material]]s<ref>P. Metrangolo et al. ''Supramolecular Amplification of Amyloid Self-assembly by Iodination'' Nature Communications 2015, 6:7574 (DOI: 10.1038/ncomms8574)</ref>
* [[intermolecular force]]s and their use in crystal engineering<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.iupac.org/nc/home/projects/project-db/project-details.html?tx_wfqbe_pi1%5bproject_nr%5d=2009-032-1-100|title= Metrangolo chaired an ICSU-IUPAC project on the terminology of crystal engineering}}</ref>
* [[nanomedicine]]<ref>P. Metrangolo et al. ''19F Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI): From Design of Materials to Clinical Applications'' Chemical Reviews 2015, 115, 1106–1129 (DOI: org/10.1021/cr500286d)</ref>

==Honors and awards==
* ''ERC Grantee'' (2012, [[European Research Council]])<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.foldhalo.eu|title=ERC project FOLDHALO ''Folding with Halogen Bonding''}}</ref>
* ''[[CrystEngComm]] Sponsored Lectureship'' at the 42nd [[International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry|IUPAC]] World Chemistry Congress (2009)
* ''Young Observer'' at the 45th IUPAC General Assembly (2009)
* ''Journals Grant Award for International Authors'' (2005, [[Royal Society of Chemistry]])
* ''[[Giacomo Luigi Ciamician|G. Ciamician]] Medal'' (2005, [[Italian Chemical Society]])<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.soc.chim.it/sites/default/files/users/div_organica/albo%20medaglia%20Ciamician%202014.pdf|title=''G. Ciamician Medal'' to Pierangelo Metrangolo}}</ref>
* Titular Member of the IUPAC's Division I ''Physical and Biophysical Chemistry''<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.iupac.org/nc/home/about/members-and-committees/db/division-committee.html?tx_wfqbe_pi1%5Btitle%5D=Physical%20and%20Biophysical%20Chemistry%20Division&tx_wfqbe_pi1%5Bpublicid%5D=100|title=IUPAC's Division 1: Titular Members}}</ref> (2016–2017)
* Co-editor of ''[[Acta Crystallographica#Acta Crystallographica Section B|Acta Crystallographica B]]''<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://journals.iucr.org/b/|title=Acta Crystallographica B: Editorial Board}}</ref> ([[International Union of Crystallography]]) (2014 onwards)
* Member of the editorial board of ''[[International Union of Crystallography|CrystEngComm]]''<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.rsc.org/publishing/journals/ce/staff.asp|title=CrystEngComm: Editorial Board|date=2015-05-22}}</ref> (Royal Society of Chemistry) (2013 onwards)
* Member of the editorial advisory board of ''[[Crystal Growth & Design]]''<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://pubs.acs.org/page/cgdefu/editors.html|title=Crystal Growth & Design: Editors}}</ref> ([[American Chemical Society]]) (2014 onwards)
